Q5910.reason: Restriction (23) is a use restriction enforceable in equity against later owners with notice under the common scheme, i.e., an equitable servitude.

Q5623.reason: The anchorman's commentary on a matter of public interest is privileged and protected opinion, barring the privacy claim.
